text:
Sam W.: Hi — first-day setup Q. Laptop arrived but MDM shows 'unenrolled' and FileVault says 'Off'. Do I need to wipe and re-enroll or can IT push FileVault? I'm in EU region, want to start today.

it-bot: Hi Sam — created ticket #IT-4821 and pinged eng-infra. If you want to check right away, run: ```macOS: sudo fdesetup status
Windows: manage-bde -status C:\
Linux: lsblk -o NAME,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT``` Send the output here or attach to the ticket and we'll triage.

Jordan P.: FYI EU devices must use company KMS for disk keys per policy, so MDM enrollment is required. @security-ops can confirm if any regional caveats apply.

security-ops: Hey Sam — quick checklist: required = full-disk encryption (FileVault/BitLocker/LUKS), MDM enrollment, company SSO, and disk-key escrow to our KMS. Loaner devices OK but IT must image and escrow keys. If auto-enroll fails we'll reprovision — no personal iCloud.

Sam W.: I ran `fdesetup` — it returns 'FileVault is Off'. It asked me to sign into iCloud when I tried to enable it manually. Is that normal? I don't want to link my personal iCloud.

Elaine C.: Don't use personal iCloud. Stop that flow. Use the Automated Device Enrollment (DEP) / MDM path. IT will enable FileVault via MDM and escrow the key to KMS. See internal KB: https://intranet.redwood/security/device-encryption (internal).

it-bot: @Sam W. Ticket IT-4821 updated: assigned to @Jordan P. ETA ~2 hours. Reply with 'urgent' if you need immediate hands-on.

Sam W.: thanks. Also — quick policy Q: I need to run some remote test VMs hosted outside company infra for a prototype. Are split-VPN or split-tunnel setups allowed, or do I need an exception?

Jordan P.: For dev workflows, split-tunnel might be allowed only on Dedicated seats with strict egress rules and approved images. Default is full-tunnel VPN. To request an exception use the VPN exception form (include IPs/ports, justification). Link: https://intranet.redwood/security/vpn-exceptions

security-ops: To request an exception include: justification, data classification, list of external IPs/ports, mitigations (host firewall, approved base image), and duration. We aim to review within 3 business days. Reminder: production credentials must never be used on exception VMs.

Maya (People Ops): Quick reminder for new hires — complete the Security Awareness training + phishing sim enrollment by EOD day 3. Trainings will come from trainings@redwood. If you don't receive it, ping me here.

Sam W.: One more — SSH keys: can I reuse a personal key for work or should I generate a new one?

Elaine C.: Bring the public key if you want to add it, but best practice is generate a new work-only key. Example: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sam.w@redwood.com"``` Don't reuse passphrases from personal accounts.

Jordan P.: Also enable YubiKey for admin access where required. If you need one, @Maya can order/loan one.

Maya (People Ops): Ordering YubiKeys this week for new hires who request them. Reply with color preference (:small_blue_diamond: / :small_orange_diamond:) and whether you need a loaner.

Sam W.: Thanks all — I'll attach the `fdesetup` output to IT-4821 and wait for the push. Appreciate the quick help :wave:

security-ops: (reacted :white_check_mark:)
